# BLD-006 — Build Artifacts

## Metadata

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Identifier | BLD-006 |
| Title | Build Artifacts |
| Category | Build |
| Version | 1.0.0 |
| Status | Approved |
| Date | 2026-08-04 |

---

# 1. Purpose

This document defines the official build artifact standards for the FamilyOS
platform.

The objective is to ensure that generated artifacts are identifiable,
traceable, validated, secure, and suitable for distribution.

---

# 2. Scope

This document applies to:

- software packages;
- generated files;
- release outputs;
- plugin packages;
- documentation artifacts;
- deployment artifacts.

---

# 3. Artifact Principles

FamilyOS artifacts SHALL be:

- identifiable;
- versioned;
- validated;
- traceable;
- protected.

---

# 4. Artifact Definition

A build artifact is any output generated by a build process.

Examples include:

- application packages;
- plugin packages;
- archives;
- generated documentation;
- deployment files.

---

# 5. Artifact Identification

Artifacts SHOULD include:

- name;
- version;
- build identifier;
- creation information.

Artifact naming SHALL remain consistent.

---

# 6. Artifact Versioning

Artifacts SHALL follow FamilyOS versioning practices.

Version information SHOULD identify:

- release version;
- compatibility information;
- build context.

---

# 7. Artifact Metadata

Artifacts SHOULD provide metadata including:

| Metadata | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Version | Identify artifact release |
| Source Reference | Trace origin |
| Build Information | Identify generation process |
| Validation Status | Confirm verification |

---

# 8. Artifact Integrity

Artifacts SHALL protect integrity.

Integrity mechanisms MAY include:

- checksums;
- signatures;
- validation records.

---

# 9. Artifact Storage

Artifact storage SHOULD provide:

- controlled access;
- traceability;
- retention management;
- reliable retrieval.

---

# 10. Artifact Validation

Artifacts SHALL be validated before publication.

Validation SHOULD confirm:

- successful generation;
- required tests;
- quality requirements;
- security requirements.

---

# 11. Artifact Security

Artifacts SHALL protect against:

- unauthorized modification;
- malicious content;
- accidental exposure.

---

# 12. Artifact Lifecycle

Artifact lifecycle SHOULD include:

1. Generation
2. Validation
3. Publication
4. Distribution
5. Retention or removal

---

# 13. Compliance

All FamilyOS build artifacts SHALL follow these standards.

Exceptions SHALL be documented and approved.
